component.name: Real Calendar
component.summary: 13-month calendar, Ophiuchus zodiac, and 369 time reading

description.p: Adds a 13-month calendar (International Fixed Calendar, extra month Sol) to the GNOME top-bar date menu. The 24-hour clock and seven-day week stay unchanged. Each 28-day month has one zodiac sign, including Ophiuchus.
Non-zero clock digits map to 369 time meanings (Love, Direction, Balance, and more) and update live while the menu is open.
Keep GNOME’s Gregorian calendar and switch in the date menu, or replace it from the extension settings.

screenshot.caption: Real Calendar in the GNOME date menu with 369 time reading

description.p: 369 time reading under the zodiac line with live clock updates.
Initial GNOME 45–49 date-menu calendar with 13 signs.
